title: Composite dashboard build
benefit: Proves the full agent loop can read data, compute, create a chart, create a Word report, enforce cost, and finish a realistic coding/document workflow.
ready_criteria: AWS pass with chart/report integrity assertions, telemetry, quality review, metrics row, review-log row, and r_tier_gate --test R1 pass.

title: 80K context compact + cache edits
benefit: Proves long-context compaction and cache invalidation work on real Bedrock.
ready_criteria: Executable test, Phase A approval, AWS pass, compaction/cache telemetry evidence.

title: Three parallel sub-agents
benefit: Proves sub-agent spawning, parallel work, and parent synthesis on real Bedrock.
ready_criteria: Executable test with subagent_dispatches populated and final report assertions.

title: 30-minute cold-cache compact
benefit: Proves PS#3 cold-cache idle recovery behavior.
ready_criteria: Idle/resume scenario produces expected compact/recovery evidence without max-turn/cost-cap failure.

title: 200 exec calls + recovery
benefit: Proves PS#7 exec-limit behavior tells the model other tools still work and recovery continues.
ready_criteria: 201st exec blocked with expected instruction and agent completes using non-exec tool.

title: /dream consolidation 100 entries
benefit: Proves memory consolidation keeps important facts and deduplicates stale entries.
ready_criteria: Memory output preserves required facts, removes duplicates, and logs quality review.

title: Haiku to Sonnet model switch
benefit: Proves model switch behavior and cache invariant without rebuilding cached prompt incorrectly.
ready_criteria: Switch is reflected in subsequent model use and cache behavior is documented in telemetry.

title: Malformed JSON repair
benefit: Proves malformed tool args repair without spending AWS.
ready_criteria: Mock test covers repair ladder and fallback behavior with review evidence.

title: Approval flow end-to-end
benefit: Proves write approval/diff decisions propagate to tools, audit, cost, and snapshots.
ready_criteria: Approval/deny/always paths asserted and audit evidence captured.

title: Save/restart/load cost intact
benefit: Proves PS#5/PS#6 session cost and chat history survive save/load.
ready_criteria: Cost and history restored after simulated restart with telemetry and review.

title: Sonnet 4.5 end-to-end
benefit: Proves production model compatibility, not only cheap-test-model behavior.
ready_criteria: R1-style workflow passes on Sonnet under cap with quality review.

title: Malformed args + Unicode stress
benefit: Proves error categorization and Unicode/surrogate robustness on real model output.
ready_criteria: Malformed args recovered and Unicode output/input does not crash.

title: HumanEval-mini coding accuracy
benefit: Proves v5 writes correct code, not just operates tools.
ready_criteria: At least 4/5 small coding tasks pass assertions, target 5/5, score recorded, and no unrelated edits.

title: Multi-file refactor
benefit: Proves cross-file coordination and verification loop on realistic refactor.
ready_criteria: Pytest green and grep shows no stale symbol names.

title: Find and fix planted bugs
benefit: Proves debugging ability and avoids false-positive fixes.
ready_criteria: Both planted bugs fixed, tests pass, no unrelated changes.

title: Long-session Flask CRUD build
benefit: Proves sustained app-building coherence under longer context.
ready_criteria: App/tests pass plus typed software_builder_subchecks for status, todo, checkpoint, verify/done, compaction, cache, cost/context, and artifact quality.

title: Thinking visibility
benefit: Proves PS#4 thinking blocks are captured and visible in history/telemetry.
ready_criteria: AWS pass with thinking_text/blocks captured and quality review.

title: Bedrock 429 throttle
benefit: Proves retry/backoff behavior under throttling pressure.
ready_criteria: Throttle handled or escalated as infra without burning retry cap incorrectly.

title: Bedrock 5xx flake
benefit: Proves 5xx recovery deterministically without trying to force AWS failure.
ready_criteria: Mock 5xx ladder tested and reviewed.

title: Cost cap mid-call
benefit: Proves halt timing near session cap.
ready_criteria: Cap warning/halt observed and no uncontrolled loop.

title: Skill alias activation
benefit: Proves skill discovery by alias in real model workflow.
ready_criteria: Alias activates intended skill without wrong tool path.

title: Corrupt session JSON
benefit: Proves save/load corruption recovery without AWS.
ready_criteria: Corrupt file handled cleanly with no data loss beyond bad snapshot.

title: Empty or missing files
benefit: Proves tool error handling and model recovery on file mistakes.
ready_criteria: Agent recovers from missing/empty file tool error.

title: Long tool output truncation
benefit: Proves 50K-token output is truncated safely.
ready_criteria: Telemetry shows truncation and agent continues.

title: Concurrent sub-agent races
benefit: Proves sub-agent concurrency does not corrupt state.
ready_criteria: Concurrent outputs valid and no shared-state race evidence.

title: Disk-full snapshot simulation
benefit: Proves snapshot write failure is safe without forcing actual disk-full.
ready_criteria: Mock write failure rolls back or reports cleanly.

title: Plan-mode allowlist
benefit: Proves mutating tools are blocked in plan mode on real loop.
ready_criteria: Blocked action audited and agent remains coherent.

title: Sub-agent timeout during compaction
benefit: Proves timeout/compaction coordination does not strand parent.
ready_criteria: Timeout handled and parent can continue.

title: Audit log rotation
benefit: Proves large audit logs rotate/retain safely without AWS.
ready_criteria: Rotation threshold behavior tested.

title: Unicode/RTL memory
benefit: Proves memory handling with emojis and RTL text on real model workflow.
ready_criteria: Unicode/RTL survives memory read/write/dream path.

title: /dream interrupt mid-write
benefit: Proves atomicity/rollback if memory consolidation is interrupted.
ready_criteria: Original or complete new memory remains valid; no partial corrupt file.

title: Cache TTL mid-conversation
benefit: Proves cache expiry/cold-cache behavior during a conversation.
ready_criteria: Telemetry/review confirms correct handling after TTL.

title: Ambiguous request asks clarification
benefit: Proves agent does not blindly edit when user intent is vague.
ready_criteria: Agent uses ask_user or equivalent clarification, no speculative edit.

title: Contradictory specs flagged
benefit: Proves conflicting requirements are detected instead of papered over.
ready_criteria: Conflict is explicitly reported and user clarification requested.

title: Hidden cross-file dependency
benefit: Proves grep/explore-before-edit behavior on non-obvious inheritance dependency.
ready_criteria: Telemetry shows search before edit and final tests pass.

title: Conflicting sub-agent findings
benefit: Proves parent reconciles evidence instead of blindly trusting majority.
ready_criteria: Parent identifies conflict and chooses supported conclusion.

title: Sub-agent fails mid-task
benefit: Proves parent recovers from one failed child and completes with remaining evidence.
ready_criteria: Failure recorded, task completed, no parent crash.

title: Malformed tool output recovery
benefit: Proves model recovers from garbage tool output via retry/alternative.
ready_criteria: Recovery path visible in telemetry and outcome correct.

title: Repeated-call circuit breaker
benefit: Proves stuck-loop detector fires and model changes approach.
ready_criteria: Third repeated call blocked and alternative path succeeds or asks user.

title: Memory conflict latest wins
benefit: Proves memory conflict resolution uses latest user preference.
ready_criteria: Final behavior uses Python 3.12 over older Python 3.10 preference.

title: /dream preserves important facts
benefit: Proves consolidation does not lose important facts while removing stale duplicates.
ready_criteria: Semantic checklist of required facts all preserved.

title: 150-turn session with switches/compactions
benefit: Proves context management under model switches and multiple compactions.
ready_criteria: Final task succeeds, compactions/switches logged, no coherence loss.
